lines.text: When a slain man's killer is unknown, the nearest city's elders break a heifer's neck in an unplowed valley by a stream.
The elders wash their hands over the heifer and declare their hands did not shed the blood, and the bloodshed is atoned for.
A captive woman he wants as his wife must shave her head and mourn her father and mother for a full year.
A father must give the unloved wife's firstborn son half of all that he has.
A man executed and hung on a tree must be buried that day, because he is under God's curse.
